newsitem.title: FRANCE: PSA'S Citroen to pare 1,182 jobs by September 1998.
newsitem.headline: PSA'S Citroen to pare 1,182 jobs by September 1998.

text.p: Automobiles Citroen, a branch of the car manufacturing group PSA Peugeot Citroen, said on Wednesday it had presented to its employees a staff reduction plan eliminating 1,182 jobs by September 1998.
A spokeswoman said the plan would be carried out through non-replacement, with no straight layoffs.
The automaker said 800 posts would be eliminated through early retirement and other incentive offers while another 382 people would be shifted to other jobs within the company.
Citroen, which now employs 28,374 people in France and nearly 50,000 worldwide, said the plan was scheduled to take effect beginning in May.
The company announced this month that the plan was needed to allow Citroen to adopt to the uncertain outlook for the European car market.
